topicName: App Store and Google Play Provisioning, Signing, and Deployment
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"App Store and Google Play Provisioning, Signing, and Deployment in Xamarin"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Deploying your Xamarin application to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store requires configuring certificates, provisioning profiles, and keystores. This guide walks you through the complete lifecycle of provisioning, signing, and deploying your Xamarin.iOS and Xamarin.Android apps."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Xamarin.iOS: Provisioning and Signing"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"iOS apps must be signed with a valid distribution certificate and associated with an App ID and Provisioning Profile. Apple offers automatic provisioning in Visual Studio, but manual configuration is often required for CI/CD pipelines."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Step 1: Generate a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) from your Mac using Keychain Access."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Step 2: Log into the Apple Developer portal, create an App ID, and generate an App Store Distribution Certificate."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Step 3: Create an App Store Provisioning Profile linking your App ID, Certificate, and Devices."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"<!-- In your Xamarin.iOS .csproj file, configure manual signing properties -->
<PropertyGroup Condition=" '$(Configuration)|$(Platform)' == 'Release|iPhone' ">
  <DebugType>none</DebugType>
  <Optimize>true</Optimize>
  <OutputPath>bin\iPhone\Release</OutputPath>
  <ErrorReport>prompt</ErrorReport>
  <WarningLevel>4</WarningLevel>
  <MtouchUseLlvm>true</MtouchUseLlvm>
  <CodesignKey>Apple Distribution: Your Company Name (TEAMID)</CodesignKey>
  <CodesignProvision>Your_AppStore_Profile_Name</CodesignProvision>
  <CodesignEntitlements>Entitlements.plist</CodesignEntitlements>
</PropertyGroup>"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Xamarin.Android: Keystores and Signing"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Android applications must be digitally signed with a private keystore (.keystore or .jks) before they can be uploaded to Google Play. You must keep this keystore secure; losing it means you cannot publish updates for your app."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Step 1: Generate a keystore using the JDK keytool utility."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"keytool -genkey -v -keystore my-release-key.keystore -alias my-key-alias -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000"},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Step 2: Configure your Xamarin.Android project to use the keystore for Release builds."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"<!-- In your Xamarin.Android .csproj file -->
<PropertyGroup Condition=" '$(Configuration)|$(Platform)' == 'Release|AnyCPU' ">
  <AndroidKeyStore>true</AndroidKeyStore>
  <AndroidSigningKeyStore>my-release-key.keystore</AndroidSigningKeyStore>
  <AndroidSigningKeyAlias>my-key-alias</AndroidSigningKeyAlias>
  <AndroidSigningKeyPass>YourKeystorePassword</AndroidSigningKeyPass>
  <AndroidSigningStorePass>YourStorePassword</AndroidSigningStorePass>
</PropertyGroup>"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Creating Archives and Deployment"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once signing is configured, you can archive your application for deployment. For iOS, this generates an .ipa file ready for App Store Connect. For Android, modern deployments use the Android App Bundle (.aab) format, which Google Play uses to generate optimized APKs for end users."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"For Android App Bundle generation, set <AndroidPackageFormat>aab</AndroidPackageFormat> inside your Android project's Release property group."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"For iOS deployment, use Visual Studio for Mac or paired Windows machine to Archive and distribute via Transporter or App Store Connect."},{"order":19,"type":"paragraph","text":"By correctly managing your provisioning profiles, certificates, and keystores within your Xamarin MSBuild properties, you ensure repeatable, automated builds suitable for local testing and continuous deployment pipelines."}]
